text: Syensqo SA is a Euronext Brussels-listed company whose largest shareholder is Solvac SA, the Solvay family holding: per Syensqo's transparency declarations, Solvac held 30.81% of its share capital and voting rights on December 11, 2023.

source.name: Syensqo: Major shareholders (archived copy; syensqo.com blocks scripts with 406)
source.quote: Solvac SA crossed the threshold of 30% upwards on December 11, 2023, holding 30.81% of Syensqo's share capital and therefore 30.81% of voting rights.
